pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by the PEDIA Tape.
Pediatric hypotension is defined as SBP < 70 + (age in years x 2) mmHg

pl1: Scene safety & decontaminate patient as needed
Oxygen via NRB 15 LPM regardless of SpO reading and passive oxygenation with NC at 25 LPM
Basic airway maneuvers and management as needed
pl2: Monitor EtCO as soon as it is practical
pl4: Advance airway maneuvers and management as needed
